description: Create temp doc, select a rectangle, snapshot selection count, cleanup
source: var d = app.documents.add(); try { var r = d.pathItems.rectangle(0,0,40,20); r.selected = true; var sel = d.selection; var snap = {selCount: sel ? sel.length : -1, selType: sel && sel.length ? sel[0].typename : 'none'}; d.selection = null; return snap; } finally { try { d.close(SaveOptions.DONOTSAVECHANGES); } catch(e){} }
